system.effect: Grants the 'Explosives' Equipment Card below. Each use of the card spends 1 Use of this Pack.

equipmentCards.name: Explosives
equipmentCards.effect:
Action. Roll 2 or more Action dice and spend 1 Use.

Target. One visible space within 4 units. Every creature in that space or within 1 unit of it is a target; make one roll against each target's Fortitude.

Effect. Each hit creature suffers 2 Physical Fire Damage. An unattended object in the area suffers the same Damage against its declared Difficulty.

Surges. 1 Surge: push one hit creature 1 unit directly away from the targeted space. 2 Surges: the targeted space and the spaces within 1 unit of it become Difficult Terrain until the start of your next Turn.
